description_snapshot: Design and govern cohesive families of Codex skills and workflows. Use when adding, restructuring, consolidating, or evaluating multiple related skills; deciding whether a capability should be created, extended, composed, internalized, or incubated; defining shared contracts and ownership; controlling trigger overlap and context cost; or establishing cross-skill validation, forward-testing, migration, and promotion gates. Do not use for a single straightforward skill with no ecosystem or overlap question.

cases.prompt: Decide which of these related capabilities should be entry skills, extensions, or internal modules, and assign their shared primitives.
Audit my installed skill entry points for redundant triggers and context cost, then propose a router architecture.
Create one CSV import skill whose intent and output are already settled.
Install this existing skill from its repository.
Fix a typo in the description of this one skill without changing its trigger boundary.
These four skill descriptions overlap. Decide whether to consolidate them while preserving discoverability.
Which capabilities deserve their own front door, and which should stay behind a shared workflow?
Update the instructions in this single established skill.
